name: actual-sync
description: Automated bank transaction synchronization for Actual Budget. Runs scheduled syncs across one or many budgets (including encrypted budgets), with a web dashboard, Prometheus metrics, multi-channel notifications (Email/Telegram/Slack/Discord), retry logic, and health monitoring. Two ways to configure: (1) for a SINGLE budget, just fill in the "Actual server URL / password / Sync ID" variables below - no config file needed. (2) For MULTIPLE budgets, leave those blank and put a config.json in the Config path (on first start a config.example.json template is seeded there). See the project README.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Directory containing config.json. config.json is validated against the project schema at startup: an INVALID config.json STOPS the container from starting (it will fail/restart in the logs), so fill in the seeded config.example.json correctly before renaming it to config.json. Wrong types, out-of-range values, and missing required fields are fatal; unknown or typo'd keys only warn. Check the container logs (or run 'npm run validate-config') if it will not start. Not needed for the single-budget env-var setup.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent data: SQLite sync history and per-server Actual Budget data directories.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the service runs as. On Unraid use 99 (nobody) so it can write the appdata directories.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the service runs as. On Unraid use 100 (users).

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone used for scheduling and log timestamps, e.g. America/New_York.

variables.name: Node Environment
variables.description: Node.js runtime environment. Leave as production unless debugging.

variables.name: Config strict
variables.description: Migration escape hatch: leave blank for normal operation (an invalid config.json stops the container). Set to false (or 0/no/off) to TEMPORARILY downgrade schema validation errors to warnings so the container starts while you fix config.json. Remove it once fixed - it does not relax the business-logic checks.

variables.name: Actual server URL
variables.description: SINGLE-budget setup: your Actual Budget server URL, e.g. https://actual.example.com. Leave blank if you use a config.json for multiple budgets.

variables.name: Actual server password
variables.description: SINGLE-budget setup: your Actual Budget server password. Leave blank if you use a config.json.

variables.name: Actual server Sync ID
variables.description: SINGLE-budget setup: the budget Sync ID (Actual Budget → open the budget → Settings → Advanced → Sync ID). Leave blank if you use a config.json.

variables.name: Actual server name
variables.description: Optional display name for the single-budget setup (default: Default).

variables.name: Actual server encryption password
variables.description: Optional: end-to-end encryption password, only if the budget is E2EE-encrypted.

variables.name: Actual server schedule
variables.description: Optional cron schedule for the single-budget setup, e.g. 0 2 * * *. Defaults to the global schedule.

variables.name: Actual server data dir
variables.description: Optional: data directory for the single-budget setup (default: data/name-slug, which lands in the mounted Data volume). Keep it under data/ so it persists; a bare path like 'foo' resolves to /app/foo and is NOT in the Data volume. Leave blank unless you need a specific path.
